intent: Close the accepted Fresh-Agent v3 continuity tranche and perform the final pre-Baseline v1 provenance hardening without opening new research or semantic ownership. Enforce at the PostgreSQL layer that industry-membership model judgment runs are immutable execution provenance and that industry-membership semantic decisions preserve their identity while only accumulating equivalent supporting assertions/judgment runs and moving last_confirmed_at forward. Then freeze the validated architecture through the existing CAP-0005/CAP-0010 ownership and Baseline governance rather than continuing open-ended architecture exploration.
rationale_summary: Fresh-Agent Continuity Drill v3 has been externally completed and maintainer-accepted. The remaining pre-freeze gap is not a new semantic abstraction: CAP-0005 already treats membership judgment runs as append-only audit provenance and semantic decisions as stable conclusions that may only gain corroborating support. The application store already implements union-only support growth and monotonic last_confirmed_at, but migrations 0033/0034 do not prevent direct SQL UPDATE/DELETE from violating those invariants. Baseline v1 should lock the already-adopted semantics at the database boundary before architecture exploration is closed.
